1: ## Process lifecycle
2: 
3: - Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
4: - Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
5: - After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.
6: 
7: ## Linux browser and WebGPU capture
8: 
9: - Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.
18: 
19: ## Mobile browser games
20: 
21: - Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
22: - Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
23: - Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
24: - Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D cat simulator set in a house, with open-ended activities.
- Update the controls and cat activities: replace the mobile arrow pad with a joystick, add meow, push, grab-into-mouth, and run actions, and let Marmalade sleep on a cushion.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support keyboard and mobile touch controls; dragging rotates the camera.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest one.

## Decisions
- Use a browser-based Three.js game with a cozy dollhouse home, Marmalade, free movement, interactive activities, and a scrapbook.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added responsive game UI, HUD, controls, scrapbook modal, cat model, movement, interactions, and scrapbook in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Fixed the start-button hit-testing issue caused by a missing closing parenthesis in the vignette CSS.
- Verified Play, keyboard movement, ball interaction, scrapbook entry, and modal open/close in the browser.
- Captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/catgame-current.jpeg`; `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Replace the mobile arrow controls with a joystick.
- Add meow, push, grab-into-mouth, and run actions.
- Make the cat able to sleep on a cushion.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update mobile controls in `index.html` and `style.css` to use a joystick.
2. Implement the requested actions and cushion-sleep behavior in `game.js`, wiring up touch and keyboard controls as appropriate.
3. Test the new controls and activities in the browser, then capture and inspect a fresh small JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, cat behavior, movement, and interactions.
- `index.html`: game UI and mobile controls.
- `style.css`: layout, mobile controls, and styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D cat simulator set in a house, with open-ended activities.
- Improve controls and cat activities with a mobile joystick, meow, push, grab/drop toys, run, and cushion naps.

## Requirements
- Support keyboard and mobile touch controls; dragging rotates the camera.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest one.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Use a browser-based Three.js game with a cozy dollhouse home, Marmalade, free movement, interactive activities, and a scrapbook.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game UI, cat model, movement, home activities, and scrapbook in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Added mobile joystick and action buttons, running, meowing, pushing toys, grabbing/dropping toys, and cushion sleeping.
- Fixed prior start-button hit-testing issue caused by a missing CSS parenthesis.
- Verified mobile joystick visibility, start flow, meow feedback, run toggle, scrapbook open/close, and no browser page errors.
- Captured and inspected the latest screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/catgame-current.jpg`; `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further changes are requested, continue from the current uncommitted implementation.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, cat behavior, movement, interactions, and controls.
- `index.html`: Game UI, keyboard hints, and mobile controls.
- `style.css`: Layout, mobile joystick, and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/catgame-current.jpg`: Latest mobile gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes to `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css` are uncommitted.
- Keyboard actions: WASD/arrows move, Space pounces, E explores/naps, Shift runs, M meows, F pushes, G grabs/drops.
- Cushion interaction relocates Marmalade to the cushion and toggles sleeping; movement wakes the cat.

- Continue building a playable 3D cat simulator in a cozy house, with responsive keyboard/mobile controls and open-ended activities.

- `index.html`: Game UI and keyboard/mobile controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive layout and mobile control styling.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Continue building and verifying a playable 3D cat simulator in a cozy house, including navigable upstairs and basement areas.

## Requirements
- Support keyboard and mobile touch controls; dragging rotates the camera.
- Add a staircase to floor 2 and a trapdoor to the dark basement.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest one.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Keep the browser-based Three.js game, Marmalade, and scrapbook.
- Build upstairs and basement as additional areas in the existing house scene.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game UI, cat movement, home activities, scrapbook, mobile joystick, action buttons, running, meowing, toy interactions, and naps.
- Added upstairs and basement geometry, stairs, trapdoor, floor transitions, movement bounds, location labels, and interactions.
- Fixed `floorHeights` syntax and `interact()` null dereference; `node --check game.js` passes.
- Started gameplay in Chromium at `http://localhost:3000/`; captured and inspected `/tmp/opencode/catgame-current.jpg`.

### Active
- Finish browser verification of floor transitions, navigation, camera behavior, and interactions; a staircase interaction was visible, but pressing `E` did not appear to change floors or show a toast.
- Recapture and inspect a fresh JPEG after resolving gameplay issues.

### Blocked
- Stair interaction behavior is unresolved; last browser check showed “Climb the stairs” but no apparent transition, and the interaction prompt then disappeared. Browser console previously reported `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'title')` in `addMemory`; the code was fixed afterward, but successful interaction has not yet been confirmed.

## Next Move
1. Reproduce the staircase interaction after the `interact()` fix and inspect floor/position and console state.
2. Check trapdoor interaction, upstairs/basement movement, camera behavior, and other floor-specific activities; fix any issues.
3. Run `node --check game.js`, capture a fresh JPEG to `/tmp/opencode/catgame-current.jpg`, and inspect only that latest image.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, movement, floor transitions, interactions, and controls.
- `index.html`: Game UI and keyboard/mobile controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive layout and mobile control styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/catgame-current.jpg`: Existing screenshot; replace with a fresh gameplay capture after fixes.

## Important Context
- Changes to `game.js`, `index.html`, and `style.css` are uncommitted.
- The game server is already listening on port 3000; starting another server failed with `EADDRINUSE`.
- Chromium is installed; Playwright CLI works and the page previously showed zero errors before the interaction test.

- Continue building and verifying a playable 3D cat simulator in a cozy house, including navigable upstairs and basement areas.

- `game.js`: Three.js scene, movement, floor transitions, interactions, and controls.
- `index.html`: Game UI and keyboard/mobile controls.
- `style.css`: Responsive layout and mobile control styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/catgame-current.jpg`: Screenshot target; existing image predates the latest scene changes.
